data.name: Timotheus
data.gender_notes: Timotheus is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Timotheus is recorded in name-lists as “Honoring God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Timotheus expresses “Honoring God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Timotheus total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

biblical_reference.note: Timotheus was a disciple of Paul and was appointed by him as a pastor and missionary. He is mentioned several times in the New Testament as a trusted companion and co-worker.
